175026.overview:
Do you like tic-tac-toe? 
Do you like the pegboard game? 
Do you like !CLIK!? 
What if they were also two-player competitive on the NES? 
Well then this game's for you! 
Compete against a friend, or play witchoself (get those tissues, though)! 
There are 3 different 2-player games, along with a bonus 2-player game that you can unlock after beating all the games as 1-player. 
If you look around, you might also find ANOTHER 2-player only game that is hidden within!

The entire reason I started programming this game was to try and kind of vindicate myself in some way. 
I had already done some other games that were bigger in scope than the games of Tic-Tac XO, Pegs and !CLIK!, but didn't like how I had coded them due to being newer using 6502 at the time. 
All you have to do is look at the sources for those games to understand what I'm talking about! 
So, I went about putting the basic elements of those games into one cart, but just more standard (for instance, just regular Tic-Tac-Toe), and for 1 or 2 players. 
With that said, there is some sort of glitching that happens to the PPU during Tic-Tac-Toe that I could never track down, but ah well. 
It was a neat project.

Snail Trail, one of the bonus games, was an idea for a parody of the Tron cycles game. 
Originally I was going to have the snails move UUUUU-BER slow. 
I think it turned out better having them move at the speed they are, though.

175028.overview:
There's nothing more emblematic of the Holiday seasons than the cozy feeling you get waking to a fire and conifer brimming under with presents. That feeling of togetherness and warmth and holiday spirit shared while singing songs of the season with friends and family. That feeling of wonder as you lay in bed and imagine what goodies Santa left under your tree. Oh what fun!

It's time for xmas break and if you hope to get any awesome gifts you better get working on letters to Santa! Study Hall 2: Xmas Break Edition is here to help.....sort of.  This year we brought back NES hard*! This game will test your skills and patience, and as always we have included blinky lights. If you stare at them long enough they might help calm you down in between game overs.

*Not responsible for broken controllers. 

Study Hall....2? Yep that's right! This years xmas game is a sequel to the original Study Hall homebrew, check it out here!

This original game cartridge is built using all new parts. No donor carts were harmed in the making of this game.
If you want to play the game without buying the cart download the free rom and put it on your PowerPak or favorite emulator.

176799.overview: An early NES multigame cart compilation og 118 games that packed a lot of punch in one small package.

179447.overview: 1944 is a rom hack of 1943 - The Battle of Midway developed by LavaMind in 1994 for the NES.

180191.overview: Lucky 777, also known as Lucky Bingo and Lucky Bingo 777/777 Lucky Bingo, is an unlicensed slot machine game for the NES and Famicom. The object of the game is to accumulate coins to see some lewd pictures of girls posing. They will reveal more and more as you win more money, with the first picture appearing at 50 coins.

181034.overview:
When Okarin and his friends made the "PhoneWave (name subject to change)," they had no idea it would have the ability to send emails to the past and, as a result, change the present.

Tragedy strikes as an organization behind a global conspiracy seeks to obtain their invention and threaten the fate of humanity!

But even when the outcome changes, their fate ends in disaster time and time again...

Face with overwhelming despair, which future will Okarin choose?

Change the past to save the future!

185034.overview:
There's nothing more emblematic of the Holiday seasons than the cozy feeling you get waking to a fire and conifer brimming under with presents. That feeling of togetherness and warmth and holiday spirit shared while singing songs of the season with friends and family. That feeling of shame as you slide down the hill face first after falling trying to show off. Ah, what great times!

This xmas we are hitting the slopes and doing some skiing, so suit up and grab your gear (snowboarders are welcome too)! Score by making your way through the gates, or hit the ramps and pull off some sick tricks for big points! Be careful not to crash, it will hurt lots and your score will reset!

192582.overview: The Supervision 110-in-1 is a multicart containing 93 games made by Supervision in the early 90's.

192583.overview:
Despite the multicart's claim, only 42 games are actually included. The menu system is unorthodox, with the first 15 games on the first page leading to the other pages which can be accessed by pressing the Select button. Like some Supervision multicarts, the menu music is taken from Booby Kids. The graphics are taken from the Magic Jewelry hack that's included among the games.

Unlike most multicarts where the repeats have random letters added on to the end, this multicart uses alternate names such as Luigi Bros and Zero Wing. (The latter of which is not the Mega Drive game of the same name) The memory is likely all stored in PRG format, as the games take about 3 seconds to load when picked.

193037.overview:
For the first time in over two decades, Nintendo's flagship console, the legendary Famicom, will be getting an exclusive mixtape of music penned and programmed by top tier musicians - fitting as this cartridge features retro 8 bit chip tunes meant to be played on the beloved machine of yester year.

Only a thousand copies of this hot fire mixtape will be droppedby Columbus Circle, a Japan-based maker of videogame accessories, and 8 BIT MUSIC POWER will come with 12 original songs written in 2015.

While not an officially licensed Nintendo title, the songs written by these old school enthusiast deserve the Nintendo Seal of Approval™; the team featured in 8 Bit Power includes talent by the likes of Yuriko Keino, Namco Arcade Games Composer and Ape Escape Composer Omodaka, amongst others. As well, all the nostalgic pixel art is created by Hiroshi Ono, who also has had a hand in the Namco arcade pixel scene.

The first of it's kind, this unique musical offering is getting a lot of buzz; it's nice to see that in the videogame world, there will always be enthusiasts who truly love gaming, no matter what~ PLAY IT LOUD!

195303.overview: RIKI's third 8-bit music title! Introducing ENCORE. It's not a game, it's an 8-bit chiptune album. Basically, please enjoy while looking at the screen without operating.

196704.overview:
Based on a hit internet phenomenon, 0-to-X is an addictive puzzler developed by Nemesys. In addition to tile mashing fun, the game features an amazing soundtrack by Memblers. Some of it is almost twenty years old too, finally seeing the light of day with this release. Flash saves will store your high scores for years to come, thanks to the capabilities of Memblers’ GTROM boards.

There are 3 versions of the game - Regular Version, Numbered Version, and the Limited Version.  The Numbered Version was sold on NintendoAge and is individually numbered on the title screen.

199222.overview: This rom was released with "Kira Kira Star Night" in a magazine release.  The rom is an 8-bit illustration "art book" showcasing the developers work.

199298.overview:
There's nothing more emblematic of the Holiday seasons than the cozy feeling you get waking to a fire and conifer brimming under with presents. That feeling of togetherness and warmth and holiday spirit shared while singing songs of the season with friends and family. That feeling of wonder as you lay in bed and hope you are not getting sick!

Got a case of the holiday blues? Dr. Covio has the cure! Line up pills horizontally or vertically to kill viruses. That might sound easy but don't take too long or the viruses will start to multiply! If you're feeling lonely invite some friends (or family is ok too), there's enough room for up to 4 doctors in this office! 

Game Features:
1-4 players
Multiple playfield widths
Player speed setting
20 virus levels
xmas music!

199299.overview:
A giant bat tries to take a bite out of your face. You have less than a second to react.

Tired of "role playing" games which only teach you how to follow command menus or press action buttons? Want proper, relevant preparation for your own quest? For the first time ever, modern technology is making it possible for you to get real, active, first-person athletic and combat training against real 8-bit monster simulations in the comfort of your own home!

Observe enemy weak points, and execute real attacks with your own sword! (sold separately) Observe enemy intentions and move your body quickly to avoid retaliation! 

Technology so advanced you'll think it's already 1990! Using the Nintendo Power Glove AND Power Pad (both sold separately), now you're playing with TWICE the power!

Vanquish foes to gain power for the next battle!

199431.overview:
So you've pissed off the Gods... Now what?

Your options are limited. You can beg for mercy or try bargaining with the devil. Maybe standing around in a puddle of your own making is more your style. However, while you're mulling over your choices, you may want to watch your step because today, lightning will strike the same place more than once!

Your goal is to simply live until the next day. To avoid being smited, move left or right. Nothing else will work. You do happen to have the power to stop time with the Start button. Survive long enough and the gods will become even more furious!

201521.overview:
In this multicart, you'll be able to experience the first two games by Sivak Games. Included are the games Geminim and Siamond. 

Geminim is based on the logic game of Nim. On your turn, you must take some gems from one color away and eventually hope to be the one who takes the last gem and win the round. Version 1.100 is included. 

Siamond is based on the mind game of Simon. Repeat the pattern presented to you perfectly for as long as you can. Version 1.000 is included.

206997.overview:
This is a short hack of Super Mario Bros. with Touhou Project themed graphics.

The player character is based on Touhou character, Letty Whiterock.

210541.overview:
There's nothing more emblematic of the Holiday seasons than the cozy feeling you get waking to a fire and conifer brimming under with presents. That feeling of togetherness and warmth and holiday spirit shared while singing songs of the season with friends and family. 

Looking for excitement this winter? Gas up your racing sled and dress extra warm for this years 8 BIT XMAS title Exciteduck!

Race up to 4 ducks at a time, CPU or human controlled! Tracks are randomly generated so each race is new. First to the finish line wins, or battle for high scores!

215251.overview: On the cartridge games are repeated, the maximum of their pieces is 5 with different parameters. The most popular was the "Cartridge with gulls", which contained "9999 Games to 1" and in addition to the menu with gulls flying over the sea depicted, it also contained an 8-bit arrangement of the "Unchained Melody" by The Righteous Brothers.

217927.overview:
Need something to pass the time during xmas vacation? Endless Grinch lasts forever, or at least as long as you do!

Endless Grinch gives you a new way to play a classic favorite! Coins are capped at a maximum of 12 and slowly disappear. Run out and you die, or keep stocked and play endlessly. Rampage through randomized overworld, tree, and castle levels so each playthrough is new. Try not to go insane from the Christmas music or go blind staring at the cartridge LEDs which dance to the music. Aim for distance or score, turtle jumping won't help you this time!

218561.overview: Are you a master at Super Mario Bros.? Think you can challenge SMB2j? This game makes the first Mario look easy. More challenging levels, more obstacles, poisonous mushrooms, and crazier enemies. Built in world and stage select keep you from breaking your controllers (use A and B on the title screen). Unlike the other mapper hacked ROMs out on the internet, this is the complete game on a custom board. Mario and Luigi have different physics so they play differently. The wind works in every level it appears, so this game is tough. The game starts with all 8 stars so you can play the levels beyond 8-4. Still think you can master any NES Mario game? If so, buy this today, you won't be sorry.

219722.overview:
Your Nintendo Entertainment System has never sounded better than in this stunning follow-up to 8Bit Music Power! 

Featuring more than 15 all-new original tracks by popular Japanese game composers, 8Bit Music Power Final puts chiptunes in your console, charming visualizer graphics on your TV, and the power to remix and control the experience in real-time in your hands!

421348.overview:
Yongbok works delivering food for the 5-STAR Restaurant (which his boss says it’s a 5-star Michelin even though there’s no such thing). He must travel to various locations and deliver food boxes to various houses. But he must be careful, for there are mischievous creatures who want to take food boxes from his hands. 

These are the available actions:

Press Start or A to start the game
Press A to jump - the more boxes you carry at once, the lower you jump
Press B to pick up boxes near you
Press B to deliver one of the boxes on your hand to a client (must be in front of the door)
Press B while holding down to drop a box on the ground.

These are the enemies

Cat: if you touch it while holding a food box, it will take it and run away. It doesn't take food from the ground, though.
Bird: if you leave food boxes on the ground on its path, it will fly toward them after a while. You can jump near it without holding a box to shoo it for a bit. It also doesn't take food from the ground, but can take it from you if you're holding it.
Pit: if you fall into a pit you lose all the boxes you're carrying. Be careful near them.
The faster you deliver the boxes, the better the tips you get. Your "high score" is the total tips you got across all locations. The Restaurant rating is also tracked, where it loses a star for ever box you lost.

421349.overview:

424501.overview: Adventurer Adol Christin has washed ashore in yet another mysterious, isolated new land, inhabited by a people who sport long ears and bushy tails...and are none too fond of humans.

447492.overview: 150-in-1 Golden 1992 is one of the many multicarts that came out for families in the 90s. In this version a cartridge with 150 games in 1, but with 14 different games without repeating. 447541.overview: 1000000 in 1 Unchained Melody 95 is one of the series of multicarts that are known to come included with most Famiclones and usually have an 8-bit rendition of "Unchained Melody" by The Righteous Brothers. All of these multicars have about 6 games when they claim to have many more, a common problem with Famicom multicars. This version includes: Super Mario Bros, Battle City, Galaxian, Wild Gunman, Lunar Ball and Duck Hunt.

447586.overview:
150-in-1 Unchained Melody is series number 3 of these multicart cartridges featuring 8bit "Unchained Melody" audio.

447627.overview:

451009.overview:
The 245 in 1 Real Game is a multicart that only works on some famiclones and needs to be modified to work on an original Famicom.

This multicart is 16 megabytes in size, one of the largest available at the time of its release (it has since been surpassed by 32, 64 and 128 MB cartridges). Several of the games are repeats or hacks of other games included.

Pressing 'A' or 'B' will take the player to the next/previous menu screen. There is no way to skip several screens at once.

Similar to some later Waixing games and early high-capacity multicarts, it does not work on a real Famicom or its hardware clones. However, this is due to a problem with the PCB design and can be modified to work. It will work without modification on most NES-on-a-Chip clones.

478359.overview:
Liu Bei Zhuan is the third and final game in Nanjing's San Guo Zhi trilogy. It was proceeded by San Gou Zhi: Cao Cao Zhuan and San Guo Zhi: Lu Bu Zhuan. Unlike the previous games, this game is titled Tun Shi Tian Di 6, or Destiny of the Emperor 6, making it an official sequel to the Capcom RPGs.

like the other games in the trilogy, Liu Bei Zhuan is an original RPG that uses mechanics based on Capcom's Destiny of the Emporer games. Also, like Destiny of the Emperor, the game's storyline is based on the classic Chinese novel Romance of the Three Kingdom. In the game the player plays as Liu Bei.

The game is sometimes listed as San Guo Zhi: Liu Bei Zhuan, keeping with the naming conventions of the earlier games in the trilogy.

480712.overview:
An unauthorized port of Vast Fame's Game Boy Color game Digital Monsters 3 for the Famicom.

Like the Game Boy Color game, Shuma Baolong 4 is an RPG based on the Digimon Adventure anime. The player can select from one of the eight Digidestined (which determines the player's sprite and starter Digimon). However, not every starter mon is paired with their corresponding kid. The game plays mostly the same but much cruder, as player portraits are sized-up tracings of the original portrait graphics and damage calculation is buggy and somewhat random. On top of this, the wild Digimon that show up in each area is not accurate, as Betamon is one of the enemies you encounter in the first dungeon when normally you only encounter baby Digimon.

Most of the music consists of unique compositions, with none of the soundtracks from the original Game Boy Color game being present. At least one of the tracks is reused from Waixing's Bio Hazard Famicom game, which was also developed by Mars Production
